1.w: A psalm of Asaph. O God, foreigners have invaded your chosen land; they have polluted your holy temple and turned Jerusalem into a heap of ruins.

2.w: They have given the corpses of your servants to the birds of the sky, the flesh of your loyal followers to the beasts of the earth.

3.w: They have made their blood flow like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury them.

4.w: We have become an object of disdain to our neighbors; those who live on our borders taunt and insult us.

5.w: How long will this go on, O Lord? Will you stay angry forever? How long will your rage burn like fire?

6.w: Pour out your anger on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not pray to you.

7.w: For they have devoured Jacob and destroyed his home.

8.w: Do not hold us accountable for the sins of earlier generations. Quickly send your compassion our way, for we are in serious trouble.

9.w: Help us, O God, our deliverer! For the sake of your glorious reputation, rescue us. Forgive our sins for the sake of your reputation.

10.w: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Before our very eyes may the shed blood of your servants be avenged among the nations.

11.w: Listen to the painful cries of the prisoners. Use your great strength to set free those condemned to die.

12.w: Pay back our neighbors in full. May they be insulted the same way they insulted you, O Lord.

13.w: Then we, your people, the sheep of your pasture, will continually thank you. We will tell coming generations of your praiseworthy acts.
